_note: What you see: Organisation chart page of the municipality of Zuiddrecht: a hierarchical tree of units (departments, teams) with manager and headcount. A selected unit opens a side panel with its placements (who holds which position, from and to, with history) and its established posts (budgeted, filled, vacant). Primary action: New unit.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Organisation chart page (Organogram) of Gemeente Zuiddrecht: hierarchical tree of units (afdelingen, teams) with manager and headcount; a selected unit opens a side panel with its placements (who sits in which position from/to, history) and its formation places (budgeted, filled, vacant). Primary: Nieuwe eenheid.
